details.description: Indulge in the refreshing and soothing experience of Mapro Khus Sharbat, a delightful beverage crafted from the extract of the khus plant. This sweet and earthy-flavoured sharbat offers a cooling respite, perfect for quenching your thirst on a warm day. Sourced from hand-picked farms, the khus used in this sharbat is known for its calming and medicinal properties, making it a versatile ingredient that can be enjoyed on its own or used to enhance desserts and mocktails. Dilute it with water or cooled milk to create a refreshing drink, or freeze it into ice lollies for a delightful summer treat. Embrace the musky, green notes and the rejuvenating properties of this unique sharbat, a true taste of nature's bounty.
